Task: Add regression tests to Lib/test/test_configparser.py for copy.copy, copy.deepcopy, and pickle round-trips of a parser-raised MultilineContinuationError. Must cover with/without final newline, all supported pickle protocols. Restored exception must retain: class, constructor args, source, one-based line number, raw offending line, errors list, message.

Known so far:
- MultilineContinuationError(ParsingError) at ~line 327: __init__(source, lineno, line) calls ParsingError.__init__(self, source), self.append(lineno, line), self.lineno=lineno, self.line=line, self.args=(source,lineno,line)
- ParsingError(source): sets self.source, self.errors=[], self.args=(source,), msg via Error.__init__
- ParsingError.append(lineno, line): self.errors.append((lineno,line)), self.message += '\n\t[line %2d]: %s'
- Error.__init__(msg): self.message=msg, Exception.__init__(self, msg)
- Test file: CfgParserTestCaseClass with fromstring helper, BasicTestCase class
- Next: find raise site, existing error test patterns
